header.title: @feugene/fint-i18n
header.description: A focused sandbox for validating runtime behavior, lazy blocks, Vue integration and developer ergonomics.
header.toggleHint: Pick a locale and watch the whole page update reactively.

basic.title: Reactive `t()` usage
basic.description: Update the name field to verify interpolation and instant locale switching.
basic.escapedHint: Double braces render as literal braces; single braces interpolate the parameter.

directive.title: `v-t`, `v-t.once` and `v-t.preserve`
directive.description: Compare reactive text updates with the one-time and preserve directive variants.
directive.onceHint: This value intentionally does not change after a locale switch.
directive.preserveHint: Keeps the current text while `lab.motto` is missing, then updates reactively once the block loads.

lazy.title: On-demand component scope
lazy.description: Mount the async auth component to load the `auth` translation block only when the UI actually needs it.

partial.title: Deep JSON block loading
partial.description: A nested block can have its own loader — or fall back to the parent one. Load both and compare what ends up marked as loaded.
partial.loadTermsHint: No own loader → resolves up to `page`
partial.unloadHint: Note the asymmetry: `page.articles` is marked under its own name, while `page.terms` is covered by `page`. Unloading takes the name that was actually loaded — `unloadBlock("page.terms")` would be a no-op.

wildcard.title: Load siblings via `widgets.*`
wildcard.description: One call to `loadBlock("widgets.*")` expands the pattern into every registered direct child (`widgets.alpha`, `widgets.beta`, `widgets.gamma`) and loads them in parallel. The loaders are registered per child, as usual — only the request is a pattern. `*` covers exactly one segment; `**` covers any depth.
wildcard.buttonHint: Pattern is expanded once, then reused on locale change
wildcard.expandedHint: This list comes from `getLoadedBlocks()`, not from a list in the component — the pattern decides the composition.

fallback.title: `fallbackLocale` and per-call `TranslateOptions`
fallback.description: Missing keys fall back to another locale — globally via the instance `fallbackLocale`, or per call via `t(key, params, { fallbackLocale })`.
fallback.instanceNote: Instance `fallbackLocale: 'en'` resolves EN-only keys when the active locale is RU.
fallback.perCallNote: Per-call `{ fallbackLocale: 'ru' }` resolves RU-only keys when the active locale is EN.

scopeSync.title: `useI18nScopeSync` + `prefix`
scopeSync.description: Load a block without `<Suspense>`. `ready` flips to true once the block arrives; `prefix: true` lets you call keys relative to the block.
scopeSync.prefixNote: Keys below are called as `t('title')` and resolved as `profile.title` thanks to `prefix: true`.

memory.title: Reference counting & manual unload
memory.description: Register usage, load registered blocks with `loadUsedBlocks`, check `isBlockLoaded`, then free memory with `unloadBlock`.
memory.autoNote: Set `unloadUnusedBlocks: true` at init to unload automatically when the usage counter hits zero.

dynamic.title: `addLoaders`, `mergeMessages`, `onError`
dynamic.description: Register brand-new blocks at runtime, inject messages manually, and observe error reporting via hooks.
dynamic.errorHint: A failing loader is reported through the `onError` hook (watch the debug panel) without crashing the app.

plural.title: CLDR forms via `Intl.PluralRules`
plural.description: Drag the counter and switch the locale: English has two forms, Spanish three, Russian four.
plural.notPluralLabel: Strings that merely contain a pipe
plural.notPluralHint: Plurals are the shape of the value, so no character in a string is special — both lines below are rendered whole.

format.title: `useI18nFormat()` over `Intl`
format.description: Formatters read the locale at call time, so every value re-renders on switch.
format.cacheHint: Formatter instances are cached by locale plus options — building them is the expensive part.

introspection.title: `te()` and available locales
introspection.description: Ask whether a translation exists, and list the locales you can switch to.
introspection.liesHint: The last row is a message whose value equals its own key. `te()` answers correctly; comparing `t()` with the key does not.
introspection.localesHint: Merge a locale at runtime and watch only the second list grow: the first one answers a different question.

subtree.title: `tm()` — a subtree instead of a single message
subtree.description: `t()` returns one message and needs its key. `tm()` returns a whole namespace, so a list can be driven by the dictionary — the component never names the items.
subtree.pointHint: Nothing in the code below mentions `home`, `settings` or `profile`. Add an entry to the dictionary and the list grows on its own — press the button and watch.
subtree.addedNote: `common.menu.help` was merged at runtime. The component was not touched.
subtree.leafNote: leaf → undefined, read it with t()
subtree.pluralNote: plural forms → undefined, a leaf too
subtree.readonlyHint: The subtree is readonly: writing to it would bypass `mergeMessages()` and leave the compilation cache stale.

retry.title: `retry` — attempts, backoff, and the single final error
retry.description: A loader that throws is retried instead of leaving the block empty. Off by default; the demo runs on its own instance so the option is visible in code.
retry.optionHint: Retries live inside the block promise, so concurrent `loadBlock()` calls keep sharing it and deduplication still holds.
retry.logEmpty: Press a button to run the loader.
retry.failedNote: Every attempt failed. Only the last error surfaces — one per block, not one per attempt.
retry.disposeHint: The demo instance is released with `dispose()` on unmount: it drops messages, caches and plugin subscriptions, and stops a retry loop that is still running.
